description: This file defines the EditorManager class for managing configurable text editors within Drupal, including loading editor plugins, caching, and generating JavaScript settings and libraries for editors.

classes.name: EditorManager
classes.description: Manages configurable text editors, loads editor plugins, caches data, and prepares JavaScript settings for Drupal editors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EditorManager with necessary services, sets cache backend, and handles deprecated entityTypeManager argument.

methods.name: listOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of available editor labels keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves editor libraries and JavaScript settings for specified format IDs, allowing modules to alter settings.
